title: EPFL PhD Excellence Program
about: The EPFL PhD Excellence Program selects a cohort of EPFL doctoral students who recently passed their candidacy exam. Applications for the 2027 cohort opened on 2 November 2026 and close on 5 February 2027; decisions are scheduled for 25 March 2027.
requirements: EPFL doctoral students who passed the candidacy exam within the last 12 months, or will pass it before the programme starts in May 2027
CV of up to two pages and a support letter from the thesis director (both co-directors if applicable)

upskill.name: the course catalog
why: Shortlist matches were generic words only ("computer", "vision", "student", "program"), not a genuine match for a doctoral programme open to all EPFL fields; fallback to the Academy catalog.

card_alt: Card for the EPFL PhD Excellence Program at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland, deadline 5 Feb 2027. The photo shows Zermatt and the Matterhorn with a Swiss flag, not Lausanne.
